id.description: Stable slug id. Never reused once published.

sourceRef.description: Where a fact comes from. Exactly one of: upstream path (+#section), URL (+retrieved), or video URL (+timestamp). The evidence fields (comment_id, quote, body_sha256, archived, role) are written by scripts/src/corpus/promote.ts and prove what a cited comment said when it was quoted.

ref.description: upstream/<repo>/<path>#<section>, or https URL, or video URL

retrieved.description: Required for URLs that are not pinned upstream files

fix_index.description: Index into fix[] for role fix or confirmation

comment_id.description: GitHub comment id; 0 = the issue body

quote.description: Verbatim span of the cited comment, 5-60 words

body_sha256.description: sha256 of the normalised comment body at retrieval

archived.description: Wayback snapshot of the cited URL taken at promotion

sources.description: May be empty ONLY when unverified is true (enforced by scripts/validate).

point3.description: [x, y, z] in metres, assembly frame, Y-up

licence.description: SPDX identifier of the upstream asset, e.g. Apache-2.0
